entities.summary: Matthias Reim is a German pop and Schlager singer. His 1990 single "Verdammt, ich lieb' dich" was a hit in several European countries and spent 16 consecutive weeks at the number 1 spot in the German charts. He unexpectedly returned 23 years later to the top on the charts with "Unendlich" in 2013.
